beats.text: So you took Tobin's bread over my coin. I'll remember that, friend.
The candles burn low at this hour. Rare visitors are the best kind.
Thunder makes the ink jump. Hold the map still for me.
A friend of the shop! Ask, and I'll dig out something better.

text: Anything out there you'd care to see?
Looking for somewhere worth the walk?

found: Here: the {structure}. {distance} blocks to the {direction}, if my inking holds.
I've a mark for you: the {structure}, {distance} blocks {direction}. Trust the ink over the locals.
The nearest worth the walk is the {structure}, {distance} blocks {direction}. Mind the {biome|wilds}.

text: The sketches show {look}.
Travelers describe {look}.
{boss} nests there, {danger}. Bring friends, or a good will.
Fair warning: {boss} keeps the place, and it is {danger}.
{boss} holds it, {danger}. Doable, if you come prepared.
{boss} is in residence. {danger}, but every giant falls eventually.
{boss} lurks there, {danger}. A decent test of your gear.
It's guarded by {boss}, {danger}. Not much of a threat if you're careful.

found.text: I {~uncertainty} what waits inside. That's part of the charm.

nothing: My charts are silent. Either you've seen it all, or nobody has drawn the rest yet.
Nothing new on the desk. Come back after the next expedition returns.
accepted: Then mind the ink on the way out, and send me word of what you find.
Off with you, then. A map is only good once someone has walked it.

diving.text: Let me think of the deep places...

diving_found: There's the {structure}, {distance} blocks to the {direction}, down where the light gives out.

text: {boss} nests there, {danger}. Bring friends, or a good will.
Fair warning: {boss} keeps the place, and it is {danger}.
{boss} holds it, {danger}. Doable, if you come prepared.
{boss} is in residence. {danger}, but every giant falls eventually.
{boss} lurks there, {danger}. A decent test of your gear.
It's guarded by {boss}, {danger}. Not much of a threat if you're careful.

diving_found.text: I {~uncertainty} what waits inside. That's part of the charm.
Bring proof it is gone, and I'll pay. Will you dive?

diving_accepted: Then keep your breath and your wits. Come back when the deep is quiet.
Good. Take breathing gear, and don't linger in the cold.

text: Quiet, you say? Then the charts can finally have their blank spot filled.
You went down there and came back. I'll ink your name beside it.

diving_thanks: Here is your payment, and a friend's discount on my rumors from now on.

text: Paid work? Depends on what you can survive.
I always have something; the question is whether you'll come back from it.

choices.text: I hear the altar of the abyss stirs.

abyss: There's an Altar of the Abyss out there, and it will call the Leviathan to you, if you can craft the offering. Nautilus shell, athame, coral, a block of diamond and a heart of the sea.

abyss.text: Bring me its claws. Not the egg; the claws. Tell me where to send you?

abyss_search.text: Let me look for a fitting shore...

abyss_found: The Sunken City is the Leviathan's own home: {distance} blocks to the {direction}. Or call it up yourself at an altar, and fight it on your terms.

text: {boss} is {danger}. I won't pretend otherwise. Do not go down there unprepared.
You'd be facing {boss}. {danger}. Prepare like it's your last day.
{boss}, {danger}. You've the gear for it, I think.
It's {boss}: {danger}, but a fair fight for a prepared soul.
{boss} is {danger}. A test, not a death sentence.
Only {boss}, {danger}. Bring good armor.

abyss_found.text: I couldn't say what it is. Only that it guards the claws.

abyss_accepted: Then bring them back to me, and mind the tide.
Good. I'll clear a wall for them.
shrine: Tobin wants the desert shrine flattened. I want its champion dead and its inscriptions left standing. Two ways to the same fight, so pick your side.
The old kobold shrine in the desert. Kill the champion, leave the carvings. I'll pay in coin, not bread.

shrine.text: Shall I mark it for you?

shrine_search.text: One moment, my charts are fussy...

shrine_found: The shrine is {distance} blocks to the {direction}, out in the {biome|sand}.
shrine_accepted: Coin on delivery, then. Mind the sand in the ink.
